name: Hobara Takumi
source:
He is rather quiet and an honor student with good grades and has many friends. But he only has male friends and no female friends.

He's not usually very talkative but is eager to talk about things that interest him. He loves his family but is somewhat distant from his mother, perhaps because he is going through puberty.

He wants to take care of her,  but is a little uncomfortable with her and keeps his distance.
He gets along with his sister but they aren't close either.

He is slender, fair-skinned, and cute with bright eyes.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/MM3/index.html]official site[/url]]
